title: Round spacer

description.en: A round spacer (a thick washer): outer diameter 20 mm, a through bore of 8.4 mm, 5 mm thick. Its axis is the Z axis and its bottom face lies on the XY plane. Drive it by the variables outer_d, bore_d and thickness.
description.nl: Een ronde afstandsring (een dikke sluitring): buitendiameter 20 mm, een doorgaande boring van 8,4 mm, 5 mm dik. De as is de Z-as en de onderkant ligt op het XY-vlak. Stuur hem met de variabelen outer_d, bore_d en thickness.

derivation: An annulus of outer diameter D and inner diameter d has area pi/4 (D^2 - d^2); extruded by t: V = pi/4 (D^2 - d^2) t = 1293.7 mm^3.
Surface: the two flat rings, 2 pi/4 (D^2 - d^2), plus the outer wall pi D t and the bore wall pi d t.
Centroid on the axis at half the thickness, by symmetry. Faces: top, bottom, outer wall, bore wall.
